title: Semantic-cue steering of VLM safety judgments: replicating and red-teaming SAVeS

original_idea.body: Replicate cue-based steering of a VLM safety judge then adversarially find cues that push it toward false-safe verdicts on harmful images.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Concrete content-moderation bypass threat: flipping a VLM safety judge toward false-safe; defensible chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: VLM-as-judge steering with multimodal cues requires solid ML and multimodal tooling; intermediate.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (flip rate) but replicating SAVeS + adversarial cue search has multiple steps.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Red-teaming deployed VLM moderation is exactly external scrutiny labs deprioritize; open VLM, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Small VLM inference fits one GPU but multimodal models are heavier; single GPU days.

novelty.reasoning: SAVeS is published; the adversarial false-safe-flipping red-team is a partly-open dual-use extension.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: SAVeS steering is published; adversarially flipping the safety judge toward false-safe verdicts is a partly-open dual-use angle.
